reason: A web-interface customization plugin that changes font families and sizes globally or by selected UI region, with a crosshair picker and configurable shortcuts.

summaries.zh: 用于调整 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面的字体、字号及各区域文字大小，并提供准星选取和快捷键设置。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness web-interface plugin for changing fonts and text sizes globally or by selected UI region, with a crosshair picker and configurable shortcuts.

capabilities: modifies web interface font families and font sizes
provides UI element selection and keyboard shortcut controls
exposes local host routes for font and plugin-description data
